responsibility: This header defines the non-SVE AArch64 builtin type metadata shared by builtin registration and expansion code. It declares the qualifier bitmask used to describe builtin argument and result properties, enumerates the internal AdvSIMD type IDs generated from `aarch64-simd-builtin-types.def`, and defines the `aarch64_simd_type_info` and GC-managed tree side tables that map those IDs to names, manglings, machine modes, and GCC `tree` nodes for `aarch64-builtins.cc`.
same_name_distinction: This is the header side of the non-SVE AArch64 builtins pair: unlike `gcc/config/aarch64/aarch64-builtins.cc`, which registers, folds, resolves, and expands builtin calls, this file only defines and declares the shared builtin type metadata tables, qualifier enums, and SIMD type IDs that the `.cc` implementation consumes.
